description: This PHP source file defines the Marketing controller class for the OpenCart admin extension. It handles rendering marketing reports, saving configurations, and generating report data for the marketing extension in the admin panel.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for the marketing report extension, managing report display, configuration save, and report data retrieval.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, loads layout components, and renders the marketing report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings with permission check and outputs success or error in JSON format.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the detailed marketing report, including fetching order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the marketing report list data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and renders marketing report data with filtering, pagination, and view generation.
